metadataRaw.title: Easy Wrist Pain Relief Exercise #Shorts
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy exercise that can help strengthen the wrist to give quick and long-lasting pain relief.

It can be done at home, throughout the day, and only requires a broomstick. Also, it may help give instant wrist pain relief, even within 30 seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
